source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
[Death Befitting an Officer](vsdata:ability/astra-militarum.leman-russ-commander.death-befitting-an-officer) on the Leman Russ Commander is rewritten. If this unit is **destroyed** in your opponent's Shooting phase, roll a D6 before its **[Deadly Demise](vsdata:core-ability/deadly-demise)** roll. On a 2+:

1. This unit is not removed yet.
2. When the attacking unit finishes shooting, this unit may shoot using [Normal Shooting](vsdata:core-rule/normal-shooting), targeting only that enemy unit.
3. After this unit's shooting, or as the phase ends if that is sooner, resolve its **[Deadly Demise](vsdata:core-ability/deadly-demise)** roll, then remove it.
